vuln_statements.explanation: This statement contains the critical synchronization logic where a race condition vulnerability exists. The mutex_lock(&fe->pcl->lock) is called without proper validation of fe->pcl pointer before accessing it, which can lead to use-after-free or null pointer dereference during concurrent decompression operations. The high relevance score (0.85) indicates this is the primary source of the race condition vulnerability in EROFS filesystem code.

This error handling path shows improper error recovery where pcl might not be properly managed across error paths. If pcl was freed elsewhere or became invalid before reaching this error handler, calling mutex_unlock and z_erofs_free_pcluster could lead to double-free or use-after-free vulnerabilities. The relevance score (0.70) supports this being a secondary vulnerability location.
